race.description: Jericho Cup Packages Available Mdn Plate
race.comment: VILLA GRANDE (11) produced a nice effort on debut in solid company last start over 1000m at this track when second, beaten a head. Takes natural improvement from that and looks very hard to catch with Meech sticking. ZERCARDY (7) resumes. He ran third on debut at Ararat and can be an improver this time around. ACHARNEE (8) showed good early speed from the inside draw last time and led into the straight but faded to finish sixth. Back to 1000m should suit and she draws well. TWISTER (6) raced once in the maiden preparation when tenth at Werribee over 1100m back on May 14. Has jumped out well since and is in the mix.
